questions.q: Why put imputing, scaling, and encoding inside a Pipeline that is passed to cross_val_score?
options: It makes models train faster on any dataset
Each fold learns its imputer, scaler, and encoder only from that fold's training rows, preventing leakage
It removes the need for a test set
It allows the use of categorical labels as targets
questions.explain: Preprocessing steps fit inside each fold, so information from the validation rows never influences the transformations.

questions.q: What does ColumnTransformer let you do?
options: Transform the target column only
Rotate columns into principal components
Choose the number of clusters
Apply different preprocessing steps to different groups of columns
questions.explain: Here numeric columns were imputed and scaled while categorical columns were one-hot encoded, all in one transformer.

questions.q: The cross-validated ROC AUC scores were 0.776 (logistic), 0.703 (tree), 0.702 (forest), and 0.749 (tuned forest). Which model did the lesson choose, and why?
options: Tuned forest, because tuning always wins
Tree, because it has the smallest spread
Untuned forest, because it has the most trees
Logistic regression: best score, fast to train, and easy to explain
questions.explain: Logistic regression scored highest and is simple to interpret. The synthetic signal is roughly linear, which suits it.

questions.q: In the logistic regression coefficients, contract_two-year was -1.81. How should you read it?
options: Two-year customers churn 1.81 times more
The feature is unimportant
Two-year contracts lower churn odds strongly compared with the month-to-month baseline
The model has an error
questions.explain: Negative coefficients lower churn odds. Because month-to-month was the dropped baseline category, -1.81 is a strong reduction relative to it.

questions.q: Why was the test set left untouched throughout lesson 28?
options: It was too small to use
Tuning against it would leak information and make the final estimate optimistic
scikit-learn cannot score on it
It contains missing values
questions.explain: Model selection and tuning use cross-validation on the training set, so the test set gives one honest estimate at the end.
